scope_chirho: Prepared source and local browser verification; no new public web deployment.

art_generation_chirho.method_chirho: Text descriptions only; no reference or third-party images. The project cropped control furniture, adjusted alpha and encoded WebP. Private masters and provider records retained separately.

regressions_chirho.finding_chirho: Looping tuning cue and four cue starts through one recovery chain
regressions_chirho.before_chirho: Focused controller and real decoder tests failed
regressions_chirho.repair_chirho: One-shot effects, natural-end unload, 1.5-second ceiling and quiet automatic recovery.

regressions_chirho.finding_chirho: Seek preview overwritten by playback time updates
regressions_chirho.before_chirho: Browser drag regression failed: preview 11 became the advancing clock
regressions_chirho.repair_chirho: Reset previews only when the stable station/book/chapter key changes.

regressions_chirho.finding_chirho: Off overwritten by the final playing-clock snapshot
regressions_chirho.before_chirho: One focused unit test expected off but stored on; browser resumed after reload
regressions_chirho.repair_chirho: Persist explicit Off after pause samples and saves the final position.

regressions_chirho.finding_chirho: Autoplay decoder fixture lacked the range capability used by source hosts
regressions_chirho.before_chirho: Saved seek was discarded in that fixture
regressions_chirho.repair_chirho: Fixture now advertises byte ranges, matching verified source behavior. No new media-seek branch was retained.

regressions_chirho.finding_chirho: An API-policy stub alone did not enable actual browser autoplay
regressions_chirho.repair_chirho: Allowed-path test launches a browser with autoplay actually permitted; rejected path is injected separately.

regressions_chirho.finding_chirho: Old pause/play-specific test synchronization no longer proved an error state
regressions_chirho.before_chirho: Later-file test sampled 2.85 seconds before continuation
regressions_chirho.repair_chirho: Wait for the power state to be off before checking the saved boundary; the expected three-second boundary is unchanged.

rendered_refinement_chirho.changes_chirho: Shared integrated receiver, synchronized label/knob controls, responsive radio-only layout; found skin padding and bezel specificity conflicts.
All three raster skins applied to real controls; corrected padding, credit clearance and opaque screen bezels; checked desktop and phone renders.

Current-color borders and select chevrons, separate light/dark focus rings, larger recording credits, distinctive digital/cyber typography; keyboard, one-commit drag, Off and motion lifecycle verification.

layout_chirho.private_render_proofs_chirho: Retained locally with the three refinement passes; public live-source desktop/mobile captures are beside this record.

supplied_audio_chirho.remaining_dependency_chirho: Source licence/provenance for the supplied recordings; the original synthesised CC0 effects remain in the public package.

limits_chirho: Generated decoder and desktop Chromium evidence does not establish acoustic output, spoken-content accuracy, physical iOS/Watch/Android behavior or full-library availability.
Autoplay depends on browser settings; a muted-only permission is treated as needing On.
Visibility teardown is exercised using a deterministic hidden-document transition; reduced-motion uses the real browser media preference.
The prior live release remains unchanged; this source does not authorize deployment.
